debpalash/VoiceStudio ↗ 1 release · 1 prerelease
v0.5.9-beta.7v0.5.9-beta.7 — VoiceStudio Prerelease2026-11-20T14:16:33Z

Download

Platform Download Signing

Highlights

  • Windows first-run setup no longer fails building docopt, antlr4 and dora-search from source (#4268)
  • Setup downloads work behind Windows system proxies such as Clash and v2rayN (#4265)
  • OmniVoice speaks region-tagged languages such as pt-BR, and saved design voices generate without a speech-to-text model (#4269)
  • Settings no longer shows a permanent voice gallery "HTTP 404" banner (#4260)
  • A failure that keeps repeating can no longer push other diagnostic reports out of the outbox (#4277)

Changed

  • Opt-in automatic failure reports now name which part of the app failed (main process, GPU or helper process, GPU job timeout or network) instead of reporting an unknown error (#4243)
  • Removed the unused retired desktop release cleanup helper and its ownership entry. (#4172) — thanks @salemalkadadi-debug!
  • Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
  • Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!
  • Retired the unreachable legacy shared UI and the guard tests that held it, repointing the live-behaviour guards to the renderer, and dropped 12 unused npm packages (#4095)
  • Smaller install: removed unused leftover images and old helper code from the app source (#4087)
  • Projects grid view stays smooth with thousands of items by drawing only the cards in view (#4079)
  • Long Projects, dub project and Transcribe history lists now render only the rows on screen, so they stay fast with thousands of items (#4074)
  • Idle CPU: a hidden or minimised window no longer runs polling timers or elapsed-time clocks, and they refresh once when it is shown again (#4073)
  • Removed unused renderer files and 477 unused translation strings, and locale:check now fails on an English key no code uses (#4047)
  • Removed more unused legacy shared components, utilities and API helpers from the old shared UI folder (#4045)
  • Local-model folder saves no longer unload the engine when the stored folder did not change (#4043)
  • Removed more unused legacy settings, gallery and engine screens from the old shared UI folder (#4042)
  • Idle polling is relaxed: the backend health probe slows when steady, cloud-sync polling pauses while the window is hidden, and the Windows parent watcher polls less often (#4041)
  • Removed more unused legacy dubbing screens and hooks from the old shared UI folder (#4040)
  • Release notes now open with one Download table listing every desktop and phone download with its signing, followed by the Highlights (#4037)
  • Removed about 25,000 lines of unused legacy interface code, two unused font packages and the always-skipped weekly evals job; the app itself is unchanged (#2603, #4032)

Added

  • Windows and Linux x64 PCs whose NVIDIA cards are all GTX 900/1000-series (compute capability 5.0 to 6.x, driver 525 or newer) now run on the GPU with a CUDA 12.6 PyTorch build, a one-time ~3 GB download on the next launch; voices, projects and models are kept (#4242)
  • Settings → General can keep VoiceStudio and its running jobs alive in the tray when you close the window, instead of quitting (#4174)
  • Stories can merge adjacent lines with the same speaker and compatible voice/speed settings while preserving text and inline directions — thanks cvak on Discord! (#4161)
  • Added separately opted-in failure reporting through Supermetry app intake across desktop, mobile and server installs, with private metadata and consent-controlled retries (#4137)
  • Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!
  • A dub interrupted by a crash or restart now picks up from its finished segments instead of starting over (#4088)
  • omnivoice-gguf now supports voice design, non-verbal tags and the decode-steps slider (#4084) — thanks @snazzybean!
  • Cebuano is now a dub translation target (#4058, #4072) — thanks @onparr-24!
  • Home shows a What's new link, winter pixel snow, a Christmas-week Santa, two rows of contributor portraits, and an easter egg that hides the credits until the next update after you visit three contributor profiles (#4070)
  • Voice Cloning has a generation queue: takes started while one is rendering wait their turn and run one after another — thanks @ItzSudhan! (#4064)
  • Audiobooks and Stories have a New project button that starts an empty draft without touching saved projects (#4055)

Docs

  • The localization contract no longer exempts the removed legacy shared i18n catalog, which pointed reviewers at a path that does not exist (#4186) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Document the enforced up-to-date merge gate while the repository cannot use GitHub merge queues (#4165)
  • Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by vinhson (#4154)
  • Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!
  • Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
  • Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!

Fixed

  • A failure that repeats can no longer push unrelated evidence out of the diagnostic outbox, so the reports that explain a session survive the one that keeps happening (#4277) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Model loading progress no longer briefly jumps back to 0% after reaching 100% (#4270)
  • OmniVoice understands region-tagged languages such as pt-BR and Portuguese (Brazil), and saved design voices generate without a speech-to-text model (#4269) — thanks @kirussantos for the report
  • First-run setup on Windows no longer fails building docopt, antlr4 and dora-search from source (#4268)
  • Downloads no longer fail at setup for users behind a Windows system proxy such as Clash or v2rayN, whose default bypass list was rejected (#4265)
  • Settings no longer shows a permanent "Voice gallery update rejected: HTTP 404" banner while no voice gallery is published (#4260)
  • Subtitle imports skip and count overlong timestamp millisecond fields instead of truncating them (#4259) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
  • The built-in browser accepts bare hostnames with explicit ports in its address bar (#4258) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
  • Export filenames repair Windows device names containing superscript digits (#4248) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
  • Windows no longer occasionally loses track of the local data folder's identity while another VoiceStudio window is writing it (#4246)
  • The backend reports the version its checkout declares instead of a stale installed-metadata cache, so a venv that was not re-synced after a bump can no longer make the app claim the old version (#4240) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Export history now records a bounded, control-free destination path and shows it only to loopback callers and administrator credentials, hiding it from trusted-network, PIN and anonymous principals (#4239) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • A backend-only test run now pins the same two isolation guards as the root suite, so a deferred model preload or the host's GPU inventory can no longer leak into it, and a parity test keeps the two conftests in step (#4238) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Electron's IPC trust predicate now lives in one module instead of five copies, and a registry test fails any handler that reimplements it or registers a channel outside the shared gate (#4237) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The route-authorization census now walks the telephony gateway's own app as well, so its voice, status and media-stream routes are covered by the guard that no mutating route ships without a written authorization decision (#4236) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The functional-CJK allowlist is now a path-to-reason mapping, so every exemption states why it exists, and a test reports entries whose reason is missing or whose file is gone (#4235) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Windows ROCm setup asks uv for the interpreter named in the reviewed recipe instead of repeating the version, and a test keeps the desktop constant in step with it (#4232) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • iOS picks the same plural form as Android for Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Arabic, Hindi and French counts, instead of always falling back to the one/other form (#4231) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • omnivoice-gguf refuses to clone from a reference clip without a transcript, with the remedy, instead of failing inside the binary (#4223)
  • Windows setup now explains a torch c10.dll "WinError 1114" load failure, naming an outdated Visual C++ runtime when that is the cause and listing what to try otherwise (#4230)
  • Trimmed speech now ends with a short fade-out instead of a sharp cut-off (#4229)
  • The startup screen only says "first run can take several minutes" while the Python environment is actually being installed, and the OmniVoice engine now reports progress during cold imports, reference transcription and synthesis so slow starts are no longer killed as "sent nothing for 300s" (#4228)
  • Windows ROCm setup prefers the AMD driver's newer HIP runtime, fixing an amdhip64_7.dll crash on dGPU + Ryzen iGPU systems, with automatic fallback to the bundled runtime (#4225) — thanks @giuseppefaro!
  • Download buttons for generated audio, batch and audiobook exports now work in the Docker/web build (#4222, #4224) — thanks @msy-jc!
  • Windows startup errors distinguish Smart App Control evaluation mode from an active policy block (#4213) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
  • Safari extension errors with WebKit top-level stack frames no longer open the repair and bug-report prompt (#4211) — thanks @karlnorling!
  • Dubbing keeps API requests responsive while marking fresh speech on the watermark worker; recovered speech retains its existing mark (#4198) — thanks @swax!
  • Stories and Audiobook keep saved audio with its original connection and offer an explicit availability check for older results (#4196)
  • The changelog reference allowlist no longer outlives the entries it exempts: two dead exemptions were removed and a guard now reports any future ones (#4188) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • HTTP error messages no longer interpolate raw exception text: filesystem and parsing failures return fixed, actionable text, and the remaining details pass through core.scrub.scrub_text to redact secrets and home paths (#4183) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Release preparation no longer aborts when the contributors block cannot be assembled, and a missing previous release only skips that block (#4181) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The commit identity check now resolves to a definite status when a pull request moves mid-run, instead of leaving a required check pending forever (#4180) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The gallery pin check now validates a pull request with the checker from its base commit, so a PR cannot move the pin and weaken the check in one commit (#4179) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Bundled installs that cannot run database migrations now enforce one cloud-sync identity per voice, so a duplicate identity is caught locally instead of surfacing later as a sync conflict (#4176) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Phone model catalogues generate on Windows again: the hash-pinned and byte-compared contract artifacts keep LF endings in every checkout (#4175) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Restrict native file-opening actions to the primary app window while preserving trusted recorder exports and window-local controls (#4173) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Community Gallery limits mounted cards in large catalogues while retaining the current preview, keyboard focus and paging (#4169)
  • Desktop failure observers retain the original consent during backend restarts and preserve normal Promise behavior. (#4209)
  • CosyVoice catalogue downloads skip unused alternative model files and use the same required assets as managed installs. (#4207)
  • Android keeps large manuscripts editable and recoverable, and retains reporting consent through permission prompts. (#4206) — thanks @gaino-svg!
  • The closed-PR CI sweep requests cancellations incrementally, preserves partial progress and reports incomplete searches or skipped requests accurately (#4189) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Kept automatic error reports bound to original consent through delayed work and recovery, and preserved native CI verification (#4184) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Windows ROCm setup preserves working-install stamps, verifies the pinned interpreter, and reports native crash exit codes (#4182) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Windows checkouts no longer fail the CLI packaging tests: the Debian maintainer-script cases skip when the host has no POSIX shell or symlink privileges (#4178) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Phone dubbing clip/stem exports check output space on both platforms and avoid false low-space errors on iOS (#4168)
  • Linux ROCm setup skips CUDA downloads and preserves its installed PyTorch stack on resume (#4167) — thanks @khryztiam!
  • GPU readiness and in-process routing reflect completed self-test failures (#4166) — thanks @khryztiam!
  • CLA audits keep exempt accounts visible for provenance review without reporting a missing required signature (#4164)
  • Release rehearsals show measured Android APK signing, and tagged downloads require matching signature evidence (#4163)
  • Manual Windows crash reports retain the faulting thread ahead of verbose status tails — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code and @freemood36-svg! (#4162)
  • macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
  • The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks hugotriunfa18 on Discord! (#4147)
  • Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
  • Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
  • Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
  • Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
  • Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
  • Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
  • Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
  • Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
  • Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
  • Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
  • URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
  • Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
  • Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
  • Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
  • Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
  • Windows installer process checks skip custom PowerShell profiles, and source installs use shorter build paths to avoid MSVC linker failures (#4099)
  • Restarting to install an update keeps update status available while the local engine shuts down, avoiding missing-handler errors (#4098)
  • Automatic blank-renderer recovery keeps the open workspace instead of returning Stories or Audiobook to Home (#4097)
  • Dubbing keeps the saved recording for cloned and designed voices with style instructions, so each segment uses the selected speaker's reference (#4093)
  • Setup on Auto-detect now retries a stalled Python download (cpython-… (download)) once from the other source, GitHub or its mirror, instead of stalling again (#4085)
  • A refused cross-site API request now names its origin and gives the exact OMNIVOICE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS line to add, so other local apps such as AIRI can be connected (#4083)
  • Setup no longer crashes with "Cannot set property code" when a runtime download or check is cancelled on Windows (#4082)
  • MOSS-TTS-Nano speaks again on a fresh one-click install: the transformers 5 shim no longer breaks model loads in its pinned transformers 4 environment (#4063, #4078) — thanks @RerankerGuo, and @rockziepromax for the report!
  • OmniVoice GGUF falls back to the CPU when the GPU backend crashes, for example Vulkan on a GTX 1080 (#4050, #4072) — thanks @MeinLive!
  • Full dubs no longer fail when translation fills segments with free-text directions like "slow"; unsupported ones are dropped for that segment (#4054, #4072) — thanks @user555gtb!
  • Audiobook MP3 exports play and download again instead of returning 404 (#4071, #4072) — thanks @dimfk001git!
  • Colab: setup cells show the failing command's output, the security-floor check judges the Mako copy Python imports, and the web UI loads through the new *.prod.r.colab.dev proxy — thanks @hkarmoush! (#4069)
  • Turning on LAN sharing no longer crashes the backend with an Internal Server Error — thanks @blutuxyz! (#4059)
  • The OmniVoice GGUF engine finds its bundled runtime again in installed apps instead of reporting it missing — thanks @b84330808! (#4053)
  • When the operating system times out starting the engine (spawn ETIMEDOUT, seen on macOS), VoiceStudio retries twice and then says to restart the computer (#4039)
  • Settings → Updates lists only your channel's releases, and Beta suggests switching to Stable when a newer stable is out (#4038)
  • SSML [spell] keeps flag, ZWJ-joined and skin-tone emoji whole instead of splitting them (#4020) — thanks @kevin9327!

CI

  • A new check keeps both phone apps' plain-HTTP exceptions limited to the local and private hosts the contract allows (#4276) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Every pinned GitHub Action is resolved against the version its comment names on a weekly run, so a swapped commit SHA surfaces instead of passing the shape checks (#4275) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The route guard now fails when a new GET route ships without an authorization decision, so a GET that starts work or reaches the network cannot slip past the mutating-route policy (#4274) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Wait for hittability before every iOS UI-test tap (#4249)
  • Every GitHub Action is now pinned to the same commit across all workflows, so a security bump reaches the whole CI instead of the files the last author edited, and a test keeps it that way (#4241) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The bundled command's install smoke, which had no caller, now runs on the macOS and Linux legs of the install job with real uv, and skips instead of failing on Windows (#4234) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The install smoke now runs for the files its build actually installs, so a change to the package manifests, lockfiles, builder config or runtime setup helpers cannot break the installer unnoticed (#4233) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • CI actions gain artifact and no-push Docker contract checks, with one bounded mobile artifact-upload retry (#4192)
  • CI pins the version of the security analyser it installs at run time, so a new release cannot silently change the findings (#4187) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Documentation and inventory changes run a read-only docs drift check on relevant pull requests, with rolling-issue maintenance kept in nightly/manual jobs (#4185) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Container builds grant the registry-write token only to the jobs that publish images, not to every job in the workflow (#4177) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • CI reuses unchanged iOS checks, rechecks shared diagnostic inputs and skips Nix builds for documentation and test changes. (#4208)
  • Windows release and optional-engine tests use portable text fixtures, native Bash and normalized cache paths (#4197) — thanks @swax!
  • Release builds load app-intake credentials from GitHub Actions Secrets without public-variable fallbacks (#4204, #4205)
  • Fixed Android screenshot capture waiting behind the optional error-report prompt (#4202) — thanks @velixio!
  • Keep iOS voice-search and download checks reliable across saved model choices (#4171)
  • The iPhone smoke test waits for typed text to reach the editor instead of reading it once, removing a CI flake (#4100)
  • MOSS compatibility tests keep checking the active Transformers version after another test restores imported modules (#4096)
  • The iPhone UI smoke test keeps its slow-inventory case loading for the whole test, so a slow simulator no longer fails it (#4076)
  • Docker's web build no longer fails the unused-key check when only electron/ is copied, and the iPhone CI job allows for a native-runtime cache miss (#4052)
  • Removed unused scripts, the old Tauri MSI tooling and leftover Turborepo ignore lines (#4046)
  • Accessibility smoke timeouts now name the requests still pending, so a flaky CI failure points at its cause (#4036)

  • @Wahap404 — setup downloads failing behind a system proxy (#4262)

cua-driver-rs-v0.55.0cua-driver-rs: v0.55.0 Prerelease2026-11-20T01:26:20Z

Cua Driver 0.55.0

Summary

This release adds 2 features and includes 18 fixes.

Features

  • keep policy-forced extensions in isolated browser launches. (#8101) reported by @ComputelessComputer.
  • download installer release assets from a mirror. (#8136) reported by @xiangxiangxiaomin-create.

Fixes

  • rebase Chromium screen extents only from a frame the size of the target window. (#8167) Thanks @CMGS.
  • read Chrome's page content on macOS on the first read and while polling. (#8133) Thanks @abonneth.
  • stop graceful-shutdown test racing the 100 ms budget. (#8208)
  • preserve Windows right-click modifiers. (#8113) Thanks @hqhq1025.
  • emit Windows agent cursor hook updates. (#8120) Thanks @hqhq1025.
  • put Hyprland browser bounds in Chromium's output space. (#8108) reported by @leonardsellem.
  • match packaged-app frames to their app in capability manifests. (#8129) reported by @tornglass.
  • accept a Windows click that closes or hides an unowned target window. (#8166) Thanks @CMGS.
  • open the macOS permission guide at the left of the screen, clear of System Settings' list. (#8219) Thanks @CMGS.
  • warn when pruning referenced release dirs. (#8182) Thanks @SssiiiSssii1.
  • cover Hyprland cursor overlay focus isolation with a live test. (#8222) Thanks @LikelyLucid.
  • rank macOS list_windows z_index by live stacking. (#8158) Thanks @S3yon; reported by @AceSilent.
  • return at once from macOS bring_to_front when the exact window is already front. (#8163) Thanks @CMGS.
  • the macOS permission guide names the app the driver runs in. (#8123) Thanks @CMGS.
  • preserve physical pixels in the embedded Windows SDK. (#8224) Thanks @wszkxlllll.
  • record background-unavailable refusals as refused and reject action truth that contradicts E2E oracles. (#8105) Thanks @hippoley; reported by @rsyuzyov.
  • let callers perform an app's own macOS element actions. (#7637) Thanks @will-bogusz.
  • admit background AX actions on Catalyst pop-up menu items. (#8064) reported by @Ed-Key.

Contributors

Thanks to @abonneth, @AceSilent, @CMGS, @ComputelessComputer, @Ed-Key, @hippoley, @hqhq1025, @leonardsellem, @LikelyLucid, @rsyuzyov, @S3yon, @SssiiiSssii1, @tornglass, @will-bogusz, @wszkxlllll, @xiangxiangxiaomin-create for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

1.2.1 (2026-11-19)

Bug Fixes

  • cargo: filter toolchain and global-prefix invocations (6c94fc5)
  • cargo: honor exclusions for prefixed invocations (5297383)
  • cargo: narrow prefix routing and pin integration behavior (17f5fdd)
  • copilot: let the repository's Copilot hook run without rtk installed (fc2d2a8)
  • core: encode sha2 digests as hex (49b1af7)
  • core: send the classifier key and reach local hosts directly on ureq 3 (4ae7693)
  • db: version the tracking and recall schema migrations (76be19c)
  • db: version the tracking and recall schema migrations (94aa52e)
  • deps: migrate ureq 3 API usage (546e9df)
  • dotnet: count distinct test projects, not path mentions (2a786dc)
  • dotnet: support quick-xml 0.42 APIs (36016cf)
  • gain: print the Pro line alone, without the opt-out reminder (8ac73d6)
  • hook: check integrity before fallback execution (7600285)
  • hooks: preserve compound user hook entries (eb710be)
  • init: match legacy rtk-rewrite hook as executable invocation (#4427) (011c522)
  • opencode: resolve rtk binary path for GUI-launched OpenCode (#4462) (2f90f4a)
  • opencode: resolve the rtk the shell runs, PATH before RTK_BIN (5b62da0)
  • preserve fallback commands after global flags (9ec581d)
  • Pro line in rtk gain, stale proxy lockfile, proxy variable docs (2304fc6)
  • proxy: bound the whole upstream request and stop re-sending a silent one (6fc6d28), closes #5048
  • proxy: bound upstream requests and relaunch a dead proxy on Windows (2443068)
  • proxy: credit proxy.request rule savings to the rule (9cc447b)
  • proxy: explain a bind failure caused by a port already in use (6817373)
  • proxy: keep a late upstream error's status on a streaming request (638d998), closes #5048
  • proxy: name the Windows task per user so a second account can install (f0a5b7a)
  • proxy: only remove a legacy Windows task the current user owns (0377db9)
  • proxy: relaunch a dead rtk-proxy on Windows without a new logon (fdb54c0), closes #5047
  • recall: keep clippy clean on Windows, where FileId is () (24ff226)
  • recall: keep clippy clean on Windows, where FileId is () (86dae67)
  • tracking: honor tracking.history_days instead of the hardcoded default (65f96f8)
  • tracking: read RFC 3339 timestamps in first_seen_days (02b1b64)

earendil-works/pi ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.6.0 Stable2026-11-20T11:35:03Z

New Features

  • GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol: both models are available on the openai, azure, and openai-codex providers, and GPT-6.2 Sol is now the default model for all three. See Providers.

Breaking Changes

  • Extension components: render() now returns readonly string[], and Container returns the same cached array while its children are unchanged. Extensions that modify render output in place, including super.render() in a Container subclass or an embedded component's output, must copy it first (#9549)

Added

  • Added GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol to the openai, azure, and openai-codex providers. Both reject reasoning effort none and minimal, so thinking level off is unavailable. Azure serves them with a 1.05M context window; Codex serves GPT-6.2 Sol with 500K and GPT-6.2 Astra with 272K
  • Added qwen4-max-preview to the Qwen Token Plan Individual providers (#12259)
  • Added deepseek-v4.1-flash and deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 to the Qwen Token Plan Individual providers, and per-plan key variables QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_TEAM_API_KEY, QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_TEAM_CN_API_KEY, QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_INDIVIDUAL_API_KEY, and QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_INDIVIDUAL_CN_API_KEY; the shared QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY and QWEN_TOKEN_PLAN_CN_API_KEY still work (#11773)
  • Added a transcript notice when OpenAI drops reasoning items from a request, such as OpenAI dropped 2 reasoning items: prefix_mismatch (details in session) after compaction on GPT-6.2. Like the Anthropic thinking notice, it is shown when showCacheMissNotices is on and only when more items are dropped than in the previous response. Both notices now name the reasons

Changed

  • Qwen Token Plan providers now use the current gateways (token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com international, token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com China), and qwen-token-plan and qwen-token-plan-cn are named "Qwen Token Plan Team" and "Qwen Token Plan Team CN". Provider IDs are unchanged, and the old aliyuncs.com hosts still work (#11773)
  • Updated undici to 8.12.4 for security advisories GHSA-mqg3-3v4r-cm32, GHSA-7xg3-fphp-28hg, GHSA-5rm8-gv32-r954, GHSA-9v6h-8rgp-m69f, GHSA-3g9m-rv3r-w5w2, and GHSA-r4pc-4jcp-7pqc (#12200)
  • The default model for the openai, azure, and openai-codex providers is now GPT-6.2 Sol (gpt-6.2-sol) instead of GPT-6.1 Sol, at the same price
  • The find tool's path patterns are now relative to the search directory, like grep's glob: src/*.ts finds src/a.ts but no longer pkg/src/a.ts; use **/src/*.ts to match at any depth. Patterns without / still match file names at any depth (#12066)
  • The llama.cpp extension now connects to http://127.0.0.1:9931 by default, the current llama-server default port, instead of port 8080 (#12001 by @julien-c)
  • Anthropic message threads are now on by default for any provider whose baseUrl is on api.anthropic.com, not only the anthropic provider (#11987)
  • The resume command printed on exit is now on its own line after To resume this session:, so it can be selected with a triple-click (#12237)

Fixed

  • Fixed read storing a note that the current model does not support images, which was replayed to the model as stale text after switching to a vision model. The image is still replaced with a placeholder per request for models without image input, and the read result now shows the warning in the TUI only, also when collapsed (#12131)
  • Fixed MCP tools loaded by tool_search being dropped on resume and /reload when an extension deactivates only its own tool at session_start, as pi-web-access and pi-subagents do in toolActivation: "auto" mode (#11996)
  • Fixed the standalone binary failing to resolve extension npm dependencies whose entry point is declared in package.json main or exports (for example shiki, yaml, graceful-fs), including imports made from inside other dependencies (#12012)
  • Fixed the find tool returning no results for patterns starting with ./, such as ./src/*.ts (#12020)
  • Fixed pi exiting with an uncaught AbortError when a read tool call is cancelled while the file is being opened (#11956)
  • Fixed pi exiting with an uncaught AbortError when the session picker cancels loading after skipping a .jsonl file that is not a session, and fixed such files staying open (#11956)
  • Fixed /share crashing pi when the GitHub CLI fails to start
  • Fixed pi update on Windows managed installs failing with "Could not verify managed Pi" when an older system Node.js comes before the installer's standalone Node.js on PATH (#12048)
  • Fixed /export HTML showing raw terminal hyperlink escape codes around links in custom tool output; links are now clickable (#12003)
  • Fixed the bash tool returning no output, with a footer like [Showing lines 3-2 of 2], when the output ends in one line longer than about 100KB, such as a grep match in a minified file; it now shows the end of that line (#12062)
  • Fixed provider errors reading "Connection closed." not triggering automatic retries (#12064)
  • Fixed /resume sometimes selecting an unrelated session while the list reloads after deleting or renaming a session (#12106)
  • Fixed Groq Qwen models failing with 400 Unexpected message role; OpenAI-compatible providers other than OpenAI now receive system messages (the system prompt and mid-conversation system messages) with the system role (#10741)
  • Fixed enabledModels/--models warnings such as No models match pattern "github-copilot/nope" being written over the interactive TUI on every /new, /resume and /fork, which left stale lines in fullscreen mode. The warnings are now shown once at startup, in the chat in interactive mode and on stderr in other modes; RPC mode no longer repeats them on stderr for each new_session, switch_session or fork (#11264)
  • Fixed the find tool matching path patterns through folders above the search path: with the project in ~/src/app, src/**/*.ts returned every .ts file in the project (#12066)
  • Fixed pi crashing with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded when rendering a very large edit diff, for example after editing a file with a multi-megabyte line, and again on every resume of that session (#8036)
  • Fixed pressing Esc during a batch of tool calls leaving the calls that had not started yet without a result in the session; they now get an "Operation aborted" result (#9986)
  • Fixed an unreadable CHANGELOG.md (pi's own or an extension package's) printing Warning: Could not parse changelog over the interactive TUI; it now shows no changelog notes (#11264)
  • Fixed problems found when replacing the session with /new, /resume, /fork or RPC new_session, switch_session and fork never being shown, for example a project extension that fails to load after /resume into another project, or an enabledModels pattern that matches nothing after a settings change. Interactive mode now shows them in the chat and print, JSON and RPC modes write them to stderr; a problem already reported is not repeated. SDK hosts can call the new AgentSessionRuntime.takeUnreportedDiagnostics() at startup and after each replacement to get each diagnostic once
  • Fixed RPC new_session, switch_session, fork and clone running extension session_start and resources_discover handlers twice for the new session. RPC clients now also receive events emitted by session_start handlers, such as entry_appended for entries they append (#10470)
  • Fixed an exception thrown by an extension's pi.events handler being printed with console.error over the interactive TUI. It is now reported like other extension errors: in the chat in interactive mode, as extension_error in RPC mode and as Extension error (...) in print mode. Errors from a handler that fails after its session was replaced are dropped (#11264)
  • Fixed AgentSession.reload() not emitting session_start to extensions when the SDK host bound them with bindExtensions({}), after it had already emitted session_shutdown. Extensions that start work in session_start, such as the MCP extension connecting its servers, stayed stopped after a reload
  • Fixed --mode json dropping events emitted by extension session_start handlers, such as entry_appended for entries they append, at startup and after an extension replaces the session
  • Fixed Could not restore model <provider>/<model>. Using <fallback> being shown only at interactive startup. Resuming or forking into a session whose model no longer exists or has no login switched to another model without notice, and print, JSON and RPC modes never showed it. It is now reported in every mode, at startup and after /resume, /fork and RPC switch_session or fork
  • Fixed git and npm output, such as Cloning into ... or added 12 packages, being drawn over the interactive TUI when pi installed or refreshed packages during /reload, /new, /resume and /fork, including temporary -e git: and -e npm: packages. In interactive mode their output is now captured, and a failed install reports the end of it. Until the TUI starts, each install is announced as Installing <source>... on stderr instead of showing git and npm output. git and ssh can no longer prompt in interactive mode: a package that needs a typed password or passphrase fails with a hint to set up a credential helper or ssh agent, or to run pi install <source> once from the shell. pi install and pi update keep live output (#11264)
  • Fixed fullscreen scrolling in long sessions saturating a CPU core by re-rendering the whole transcript on every wheel event (#9549)
  • Fixed search in /login, /logout, /scoped-models and /resume keeping the highlight on the row scrolled to before typing, so Enter picked whichever entry landed there instead of the best match; a query now highlights the top match, as /model does (#12245, #12246 by @acmerfight)
  • Fixed exiting pi, pi config and the --resume and other startup pickers dropping terminal output still queued in stdout, such as the resets that turn off mouse tracking and Kitty keyboard reporting; the shell could then print mouse and key reports as text. pi now waits up to one second for queued output before exiting or continuing (#12133)
  • Fixed moving the cursor in a search field with Left, Right, Home or End moving the highlight back to the first entry in /login, /logout, /model, /scoped-models, /resume, /settings, the per-model settings model picker and pi config (#12245)
  • Fixed llama.cpp decision classifiers ignoring the image input that llama.cpp reports, such as Clef with its mmproj; models.classify() now sends their images to /v1/systemone (#12282)
  • Fixed kill -TSTP from outside pi stopping it without restoring the terminal, which left mouse tracking and the Kitty keyboard protocol on at the shell prompt and turned mouse movement into garbage input. pi now suspends as with Ctrl+Z and redraws on fg (#12283 by @haoqixu)
  • Fixed changing the thinking level on the openai-codex provider invalidating the prompt cache on GPT-6 models (#12269)
  • Fixed unscoped syntax-highlighted text inheriting the terminal foreground and becoming unreadable on contrasting tool cards (#11092)
  • Fixed /copy saying "No agent messages to copy yet." after Esc during a tool call or after a provider error; it now copies the previous answer. RPC get_last_assistant_text skips the same messages (#12119, #12121 by @acmerfight)
  • Fixed pi.exec reporting exit code 0 for commands ended by a signal, such as a timeout, an abort or a crash; it now reports 128 + the signal number, like a shell (143 for SIGTERM, 137 for SIGKILL) (#12088, #12089 by @acmerfight)
  • Fixed GitHub Copilot Gemini and Kimi models (gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-carbon, gemini-3.8-flash, kimi-k3) ignoring the thinking level, and Copilot usage always reporting 0 reasoning tokens (#12110 by @DenielC1)
  • Fixed provider errors that report only a Node socket error code, such as read ECONNRESET, write EPIPE, or connect ETIMEDOUT, not triggering automatic retries (#12128)
  • Fixed OpenAI rejecting requests with a 400 error when a tool's schema contains a node without a type (such as items: {} or Type.Unknown()); such tools are now sent in non-strict mode (#12049)
  • Fixed Mistral Large 4 tool calls stalling for minutes; Mistral models no longer receive strict tools unless compat.supportsStrictMode is set (#12148)
  • Fixed non-strict Anthropic tool schemas not telling the model that extra arguments are forbidden (#12067)
  • Fixed GitHub Copilot models on the Responses API (GPT, Grok, MAI-Code) filling omitted optional tool arguments with empty strings or invented values (#12286)
  • Fixed the OpenAI Codex WebSocket 60-minute connection limit failing the turn when it hit mid-stream, for example during long thinking; the request is now retried on a fresh connection (#12124)
  • Fixed the openai-codex provider getting almost no prompt cache hits for the system prompt on GPT-6.2 models (#12273)
  • Fixed the openai-codex provider ignoring a model's maxTokens
  • Fixed fullscreen Kitty images disappearing after a full redraw such as a window resize (#12010)
  • Fixed text after a multi-row inline image in Markdown drawing over the image (#12017)
  • Fixed Kitty and iTerm2 images covering overlays drawn over them (#11584)
  • Fixed Enter on a Tab path menu for an absolute path (look at /tmp/fi) or a slash command argument menu (/open /tm) submitting the prompt instead of accepting the completion (#12309, #12312 by @acmerfight)

Removed

  • Removed the retired deepseek-v3.2 and deepseek-v4-flash from the Qwen Token Plan Team providers; use deepseek-v4-flash-0731 or deepseek-v4.1-flash (#11773)

A tool's own options keep the shortening (caption.py --lang).
  • More guessed names are answered. 126 calls were written by an agent shown only each tool's name and one line about it; 27 ran. Of the 64 that used an option the tool does not have, the answer named the tool's own option for 33 before and 49 after: a hint now matches words with a hyphen or a space, leaves the shared options out, and fifteen help strings use the word people reach for (--size, --resolution, --max-size, --padding, --framerate, --mode). Forty of those calls join docs/stumbles.jsonl (78 lines).
  • The probe is a skill. .claude/skills/first-try-probe/SKILL.md and tests/first_try.py hold the loop: a fresh agent writes calls blind, they are run with --dry-run, and each miss is taught and recorded.
  • A guessed option name is answered with the right one. Every tool now adds to its usage error, for each --flag it does not have: its nearest option (--treshold: did you mean --threshold?), the options whose help uses the word (straighten.py --angle: --degrees mentions 'angle'; fit.py --ratio: --aspect), and the tools that do take a flag of that name (export.py --width: fit.py and others). It is said even when a required option is also missing, where argparse named only that one. overlay.py --position lists its names when one is wrong.
  • First-try stumbles are recorded and replayed. docs/stumbles.jsonl holds each call an agent got wrong (what it typed, what came back, what was right, the class); a line marked taught is run by the tests and the tool's answer must name the way out. Five stumbles where the result is wrong and says nothing are listed as open.
  • Option names stop growing apart. The names for an angle, a strength, a text size, a duration and the rest are decided (docs/design-decisions.md, "one name per meaning"). Nothing is renamed while the freeze holds; a test keeps a new option from taking an older name and a shared name from meaning two things. Twenty-four more wrong calls, each another tool's name for the same thing, are in the ledger and answered.

v4.0.0 Stable2026-11-20T01:49:48Z

The third deliberate break (4.0.0). What changed and how to migrate: docs/contract.md, "What 4.0 changed".

Added

  • A review page for a render project, for standalone use (#633). npx ffmpeg-skill review project.json --result run.json (or python3 scripts/_review.py) writes a folder with an index.html: one editor-style screen for a computer (16:10, three columns) with the sources and their probe facts, the work steps in order, a viewer that plays the output (in a phone frame with the platform's safe area for a tall frame, as a plain monitor otherwise), a timeline with the clips, the caption cues and the sound's waveform, and every measured row against what was expected. Each element has a number (S1 source, C1 clip, T1 caption, A1 sound, M1 marker, R1 range, P1 measurement, #1 work step); pressing one adds a row to an instruction for the agent, and "Copy the instruction" gives the text to paste, with the project, the render.py command and one line per row. A work step lists every flag of its tool, read from the contract, and any of the 42 tools can be added as a new step. A caption's text and its line breaks are edited in a text box and go into the instruction (\n for a break). A clip's in, out and speed are edited in place and "Save project" saves the edited project; rendering it again is render.py as before. English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. The page needs no network and runs nothing. It is not a contract tool and the MCP server does not list it, so a caller that owns the review (Velisa) never reaches it.

Changed

  • The stability promise is split by tool. contract --json gives each tool stability: the 12 core tools are stable (the 3.x promise, for the whole of 4.x), the other 30 beta (an argument or output key may change in a minor release after one minor in deprecated).

  • Delivery templates include the applicable check.py --content rows by default (#575).

  • export.py's platform presets meet the platform's loudness by default (#579). A quiet source exported with --preset reels was delivered at about -56 LUFS with a warning; it is now corrected in the same call (-14.06 LUFS on that source, loudness.normalized: true). --no-normalize keeps 3.x's measure-and-report behaviour; --normalize is still accepted.

  • Return a verification failure when a video delivery misses a required export property (#620).

  • Ask for a duration method before making a large implicit retime in fit.py (#582).

  • Speech nobody named is no longer transcribed as English by an English-only model. caption.py --transcribe and silence.py --transcribe under --engine auto, with no --language (--filler-lang), no detectable language and only an English-only Parakeet model able to run, used to transcribe anyway and add a note saying English was assumed: Japanese speech came out as English words, and the note was read after the captions were burned. The call is now refused before anything is transcribed or written (kind: input, reason: english_only, or engine_failed when a Whisper engine ran and failed), and the refusal names the flag. Name the language (--language en for English), install a Whisper engine for other languages, or give Parakeet a multilingual (v3) model. The warning asr_language_assumed and silence.py's top-level notes are gone with it.

Fixed

  • A normalised sound stays where its picture is. loudness.py, and export.py --normalize (now the default for platform presets), played every sound after a stretch of digital silence about 89 ms late against the copied picture on FFmpeg 6.1, and cut as much off the end: loudnorm's output frames jumped in time while its samples ran on. The samples are restamped in order from the first one's time. A gap in the source's sound (from 10 ms) is filled with silence first, so the sound after it stays in place: the restamp closed such a gap, and each later sound played early by the gap's length.
  • waveform.py --at refuses a flag it would ignore. --fps, --silence-threshold, --quality, --fast, --preset, --codec, --hw and the audiogram layout flags shape only the video output; with --at, which draws PNGs, they were accepted and did nothing. Each is now refused by name.
  • fit.py --fit crop no longer warns about motion spread over the whole frame (#630). A 16:9 to 9:16 crop cuts 68% of the width, so evenly spread motion (a pan, handheld footage) always had more than half of it outside and raised crop_content_off_centre, suggesting the --crop-x already in use. The motion rule now asks for an excess of 0.15 over the discarded share, as the detail rule does, and the warning no longer names the anchor the run used.
  • A stream-copy join of AAC clips no longer lets the sound fall behind (#610). join.py --copy played each later clip's AAC priming at its seam and carried each clip's sound past its picture into the next: on eight 4 s clips the beep came 32 ms later at every join (224 ms by clip 8) in .mp4, .mov and .mkv alike, and the result said verified: true. The delay is now predicted from each clip's priming and decoded sound length (it matched the measured delay at all eight clips), and a copy join whose sound would be more than 50 ms behind, or ahead (clips whose sound is shorter than their picture pull it 10.7 ms earlier per join), at any clip is refused (join_copy_mismatch, details.aac_drift_ms); two such clips still join, three do not.
  • A still image with a % in its name that is not a pattern can be used (#558). overlay.py --image 'a%20b.png' (also 50%.png, insert.py, broll.py --insert, probe.py) failed inside ffmpeg with "Option pattern_type not found". A still with a % in its name is now opened with -f image2 -pattern_type none, which reads a literal % and a %d name alike as the one file (measured on FFmpeg 6.1.1 for .png and .jpg).
  • A relative subtitle path with a colon works (#558). caption.py --srt ./a:b.srt (and d:e/c.srt) burned in failed with "Protocol not found": the ./ was dropped before the path reached the subtitles filter. A relative path whose first segment has a colon is written ./... in every filter option (subtitles, ass, LUT, font and text files).
  • An output extension FFmpeg has no muxer for is refused before ffmpeg runs (#558). -o weird.xyz failed as kind: ffmpeg after a dry run that completed. It is kind: input, reason output_extension_unknown, dry runs included, judged by the installed build's own muxer list; an extension the build knows is never refused, and one outside the common ones costs a one-time lookup of about two seconds.
  • An input that is empty, a directory or not media says so (#558). Reasons input_empty, input_is_directory and input_not_media, each with a hint, in place of ffprobe's raw lines with a memory address in them.
  • A file the user may not read is "permission denied", not "input not found" (#558). Reason input_permission_denied, for a file behind a directory that cannot be searched and for an unreadable file, in a dry run too; join.py, audio.py, render.py and verify.py name it the same way, and verify.py no longer ends in a traceback on such a path.
  • contract --json | head no longer prints a traceback (#558). scripts/_contract.py exits 0 quietly when the reader of its output closes the pipe (README's quick start does this).
  • An input name starting with a dash is read as a file (#558). probe.py -- -report and -- -dash.mp4 failed in ffprobe, and -report left an ffprobe-*.log in the working directory. Such a name reaches ffmpeg and ffprobe as ./name; the default output named after it is written too, and verify.py and report.py pass it on as a file.

What's Changed

  • v4.0.0: the promise split by tool, platform exports at their loudness, copy joins that keep sync, and a review page by @kajisho5 in https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/636

Wei-Shaw/sub2api ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.2.24Sub2API 0.2.24 Stable2026-11-20T09:19:50Z

AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

安全修复：网关拒绝含重复字段的请求，修复利用重复字段使计费模型与实际调用模型不一致的问题；同时修复 Codex 文献检索返回 403 时 OpenAI OAuth 账号被批量停调的问题。

新增功能

  • 网页搜索模拟新增 Exa 搜索服务商，web_search 结果块返回搜索来源
  • Claude Code 上下文压缩请求按 5 分钟缓存 TTL 写入
  • Claude OAuth / Setup Token 账号显示窗口费用估算
  • 模型广场支持一键复制模型 ID
  • 频繁手动刷新 Token 时给出风险提示

优化改进

  • 网关请求体只解析一次，并减少工具 schema 清洗、命名空间剥离、图片意图识别、cache_control 检查中的重复遍历与拷贝，降低大请求的 CPU 与内存占用
  • 调度器账号缓存不再保存展开后的分组信息
  • 运维面板模型平均 Tokens/秒改为按累计请求耗时计算
  • 网关在读取请求体阶段返回的错误（如 413）改为按各协议入口的格式返回，文案与 handler 一致
  • Codex Messages 桥接把 ToolSearch 映射为原生 tool_search
  • 合成路由改写到 Claude 5.5 模型时自动适配 thinking 参数

Bug 修复

  • 安全修复：请求体（含嵌套字段）及 WebSocket 帧中同名字段重复声明时直接拒绝，修复按低价模型计费、实际调用高价模型，以及绕过账号模型映射、强制 service_tier、推理强度上限的问题（GHSA-p3r4-jcm3-2hph）
  • 修复带 BOM 或 Content-Type 标为 multipart 的请求体可绕过分组模型白名单的问题
  • 修复 Codex 文献检索返回 403 时逐个暂停甚至永久禁用 OpenAI OAuth 账号的问题
  • 修复 embeddings、alpha search、systemone 等纯文本接口的请求体上限未提前生效的问题
  • 修复 Antigravity 单个请求的裸 429 冷却多个账号的问题，额度查询改用账号转发端点，并保留上游 Gemini SSE 注释帧
  • 修复 OpenAI 上游请求超时不切换账号的问题
  • 修复 OpenAI OAuth 令牌轮换后凭据可能因补全超时或并发被覆盖的问题
  • 修复 ChatGPT OAuth 账号（含透传）调度到非 OpenAI 模型的问题
  • 修复 Grok 搜索按 xAI 返回的成功次数计费，Grok 图片编辑支持 5 张输入图并保留校验错误信息
  • 修复转发图片的 usage 被拆成多行 SSE、缓冲输出为空时 Responses 结果缺失的问题
  • 修复协议转换中丢失 stop 序列与 Kimi 工具定义、DeepSeek Anthropic 工具续接缺少 thinking 块、Gemini 最后一轮工具结果混入多余内容的问题
  • 修复 Codex 音频输入能力、VS Code IDE 上下文在 HTTP Responses 中丢失的问题，按轮次记录 Responses 推理强度
  • 修复 TypeSafe System One 未应用账号模型映射的问题
  • 修复 Anthropic 长上下文模型元数据未展示、账号测试对不支持 temperature 的模型仍发送该参数的问题
  • 修复 Claude 与 Gemini 账号用量快照不刷新、批量透传编辑丢失模型过滤、后台创建用户未初始化默认平台限额的问题

破坏性变更

  • 请求体或 WebSocket 帧中同名字段重复声明（包括取值相同、仅大小写不同、嵌套字段重复）时返回 400 或关闭连接；multipart 表单中 model、n、size 等字段重复同样拒绝。正常 SDK 和客户端不受影响

curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash

stablyai/orca ↗ 3 releases · 2 stable · 1 prerelease
v1.4.266 Stable2026-11-20T08:25:00Z

Previous release: 1.4.265: Orca Bots as first-class teammates, with a lighter desktop for busy chats.

Introducing Orca Bots (Beta) <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="36" height="36" valign="middle" />

Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer.

  • <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="28" height="28" valign="middle" /> Every bot session gets its tools and identity: Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs.
  • 🔗 Bots can share, just like the owner: Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does.
  • 💬 Slack threads show what a bot is doing: A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up.
  • 📬 Gmail triggers match the real sender: Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ.
  • 🛡️ Clearer access warnings: The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot.

We shipped two releases today. Check out the previous release, 1.4.265 too.

Sign in to Antigravity your way

Antigravity chats can now sign in with a Gemini API key or Google Agent Platform (ADC), and new chats run on a signed-in agy so chat, quota and the picked account all agree. More agents also work out of the box: Orca installs its own copies when a host has none.

  • 🔑 Gemini API key or Google Agent Platform: Choose how an Antigravity chat signs in, and see the same account in chat and quota.
  • 📦 More agents, ready to use: Orca installs its own OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Grok, Kimi Code and OMP when a host has none, and offers CLI updates for every native-chat agent.
  • 🛡️ Steadier Antigravity on every platform: Auto-updates stay off for host launches, Windows discovery and hook timing are fixed, and the reviewer decides on tool use.
  • 🖼️ Image previews: Recent pasted and dropped images show a preview, and Codex CLI image previews work.
  • 📱 A friendlier phone: Unread bells on agent rows and session tabs, your host's Orca version with update steps, and no more endless spinners on desktops it cannot reach.

Highlights

Bots, comments and the sidebar. Reorder Bots and Projects in the sidebar, write longer item comments in a stacked composer, step through items without leaving it, and reply to an open question straight from its card in Activity. The collapsed Bots sidebar is clearer, and Slack mentions in agent chat show as names.

Quieter, calmer chats. Finished quiet turns hide their Worked for bar with a gentle fade, and resume-on-restart is a small toast instead of a dialog. Terminal tabs keep their name after they close and on resume.

Built for paired servers. Open localhost links from SSH and paired hosts in that host's Orca browser, play video and audio in remote HTML previews, and read and change a server's notification switches from a paired client. Headless servers stop advertising updates they cannot perform.

Lighter on your machine. Session saves keep unchanged entries identical, host status work happens only for hosts that changed, and Windows tools launch from absolute System32 paths. Linux opens a password-less keyring before falling back, and repackaged .deb installs are no longer handed to dpkg.

Phone compatibility. The phone changes listed below are source changes included in this release boundary. Installing this desktop update does not install a mobile app update; those features require the corresponding mobile build.

v1.4.265 Stable2026-11-19T23:41:51Z

Previous release: 1.4.264 — Chat commands find their workspace, keeping browser work with the right chat.

Introducing Orca Bots (Beta) <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="20" height="20" valign="middle" />

Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: every managed agent session gets its tools and identity, bots can share on the owner's behalf, they follow Slack threads and Gmail triggers more reliably, and connecting them is clearer and safer.

  • <img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stablyai/orca/main/src/shared/bot-mascots/A1.webp" alt="Orca" width="20" height="20" valign="middle" /> Every bot session gets its tools and identity: Managed agent sessions are no longer limited to Claude and Codex; each one starts with the tools and identity it needs.
  • 🔗 Bots can share, just like the owner: Agent CLI callers can use Sharing the same way the owner does.
  • 💬 Slack threads show what a bot is doing: A thread now reflects what its turn is working on, and long answers arrive whole instead of cut up.
  • 📬 Gmail triggers match the real sender: Triggers match the sender's actual address, not a display name that can differ.
  • 🛡️ Clearer access warnings: The access confirm dialog now spells out what you are allowing before you connect a bot.

Highlights

Bots, connectors and access. Connect a bot through a faster connector picker with category icons, a trimmed Slack connect dialog that shows how to mention the bot once it is installed, and a clearer access-control warning. Other conversations are listed for reference only in an agent's context, so a bot stays focused on the one it was asked about. Finish alerts and worker stop reports carry the reply a transcript read adds, and agents are told which mail type to set, including over --on.

A lighter desktop for busy chats and terminals. Long tab strips render only the visible region, session saves write changed entries, new messages get through while other chats stream, and a terminal scroll loop that could freeze the window is fixed.

Send while other chats stream. A new chat’s sending work gets priority over background streaming writes. Hidden composers also stop listening to every keystroke, and closed chats release status rows they no longer need. These changes reduce competing work when several conversations are active.

Read status without losing the thread. Expand activity rows for details or open a subagent’s own view. Text before a question remains visible after the turn folds, retained diagrams survive workspace switches, and failed loads of earlier messages offer Retry.

Use the agent on the right host. Claude and Codex installation follows the host where the chat runs. An existing personal installation takes precedence; Orca’s managed copies are available to its terminals too. Remote account controls and usage displays also receive fixes.

Choose automatic desktop updates. Enable Automatic updates in Settings → General → About to let Orca download, install and relaunch using your update cadence, channel and delay. It defaults to off. Automatic installation waits if it would terminate a live or launching in-process terminal, a WSL move is active, or window state cannot be saved.

Phone compatibility. The phone changes listed below are source changes included in this release boundary. Installing this desktop update does not install a mobile app update; those features require the corresponding mobile build.

android-v0.0.68Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.68 Prerelease2026-11-19T21:15:39Z

Previous Android release: 0.0.67

More control over chats and terminals from your phone ✨

Android 0.0.68 brings together improvements for starting agents, following their work and returning to earlier sessions. With an updated paired host, you can choose the workflow you want and do more of the follow-up from your phone.

  • 💬 Start in Chat or CLI: Choose a surface in the New Tab sheet instead of relying entirely on the host's default. Your phone remembers your choice; agents that cannot run in Chat still open in the CLI.
  • 🔎 Find and revisit past work: Agent History adds agent and sort filters, searches across the whole project, and offers to resume interrupted chats after the computer restarts.
  • 🔔 See which agent needs a read: Unread bells appear on workspace agent rows and session tabs, including collapsed groups. Viewing the agent's tab marks its reply read.
  • ✍️ Follow up on a specific passage: Select text in an agent reply and tap Quote to bring it into your draft, ready for your question.

Highlights

More capable phone chats. Use /fork to branch a conversation and /usage to inspect usage. /resume, /side and /btw are labeled as desktop-only rather than being sent to the agent as ordinary text. Pasted images also stay inside the Claude prompt they belong to.

A terminal you can tailor. Set terminal font, size, line spacing and weight, or adjust chat and terminal text size from the session menu. On Windows hosts, choose PowerShell, CMD, Git Bash or WSL when opening a terminal. Ctrl+Enter now matches desktop encoding on supported hosts; Windows or unknown hosts keep Enter behavior unless enhanced keyboard support is negotiated. Larger terminal pastes are sent in chunks, with the clipboard bridge retaining its own size limit.

Keep GitHub updates on GitHub. GitHub-installed Android copies now open GitHub for their updates, fixing the previous release's routing to Google Play before an update was available there.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

Download the Android APK from this release's assets. The phone interface is supplied by your paired desktop or server: update that host too for the features above. Older hosts can omit the Chat/CLI picker and unread indicators. This announcement covers the GitHub Android build; it does not announce Play Store or iOS availability.

What's Changed

The complete public change inventory for this Android source span follows. Shared-source desktop changes require a desktop update; installing the APK alone does not update a paired host.

Phone & paired devices

Phone chat, terminal, history and workspace updates. The session-header Chat/Terminal menu addition in #42897 was reverted by #43313; the new-agent Chat/CLI picker is a separate change.

v0.23.3Hermes Agent v0.23.3 Stable2026-11-20T00:34:38Z

Hermes Agent v0.23.3

Release Date: November 19, 2026

Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~370 PRs merged since v0.23.2 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

About this release

Measured at commit caafe5389ae, the window since v0.23.2 contains 1,657 non-merge commits across 3,948 changed files (+222,379 / −96,154), 370 merged PRs and 60 closed issues.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: one prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compaction of idle chats before the 1h cache expires, Nous Portal on the full 1h lifecycle, prompt_caching.cache_ttl defaulting to auto), compaction that archives the tool results it drops, the proactive tool-result prune on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup with the free tier included, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) on OpenRouter and Nous Portal, a "Waiting on teammates" strip above Bot Chat composers, the Linux AppImage agent payload run from a stable per-build copy, the storage layer split behind a persistence interface with its SQLite backend, dependency security bumps (oauthlib, opentelemetry, tornado), and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

Updating

  • Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
  • Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
  • CLI: hermes update, or re-run the installer one-liner.
  • Docker / Hermes Cloud: nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable (or :latest).
