rea-agents-6.10.1rea-agents: v6.10.1 Stable2026-11-20T05:30:51Z

6.10.1 (2026-11-20)

This is the first 6.10 release published to npm. It includes the changes, migration notes, and contributor credits from 6.10.0 below, plus the patch fix.

Bug Fixes

  • kuna: use one constant for the serial job count (#12735) (3e3faf2)

6.10.0 (2026-11-20)

Highlights

  • Inspect and extract UEFI firmware volumes, files, and AMI NVRAM with three offline CLI and MCP tools. #12342. Thanks @bartman081523.
  • Inspect Android boot images and OTA payloads, NES 2.0 containers, and Maven, Gradle, and NuGet package metadata. a88c0a5 #9487 #11378 #10674 05be423 #10353 43b9fa8 #10351 #8144. Thanks @Davmunrey, @gensokyo-dev, @jayykernel, @mvanhorn.
  • Evidence revision 2 gives file, process, debugger, and browser observations explicit subject identities. See the migration details below.
  • The verified Ghidra 12.2 lane opens recognized DOS COM files and supports more RISC-V, MIPS32, and PowerPC64 ELF targets. #4811 #4487 #2362 #2338 #12517 #12085. Thanks @abhay-2108, @AurelioB, @Davmunrey, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Rinkia.

Changes

  • JavaScript semantic indexing uses fixed object shapes for nested evaluation contexts to reduce allocation overhead. #9007. Thanks @mshzy.
  • Inspect ELF dynamic dependencies and required symbol versions, resolve separate debug-file linkage, inspect DWARF compilation units offline, and decode FDO packaging and dlopen notes. e9c72db #7868 54e3918 #9560 637e4cb #8523 #7237 #7235. Thanks @AniketR10, @gensokyo-dev, @mvanhorn.
  • Read cargo-auditable dependencies from WebAssembly and export Go and Rust dependency Evidence as CycloneDX. #5069 237b1ea #8445. Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @mvanhorn, @yu0809.
  • Decode CPython 3.14 and 3.15 bytecode and use Kuna 1.1000. 1d08253 #10518 #12107. Thanks @abhisheksharma001, @gensokyo-dev, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Managed member inspection retains unresolved_definitions and summarizes unresolved definition coordinates. Native inspection surfaces prototype instruction conflicts, resolves RISC-V initializer pointers, and identifies which Mach-O slices a signature covers. #12462 #8161 #1244 #12109 #11620. Thanks @akshad-exe, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • GDB and Rizin explain why stopped sessions reject commands and why a debugger stop or close could not finish. #11652 #11517 #11185.
  • Setup manages fx, Junie, Goose, and Kilo registrations, supports explicit MCP catalog profile selection, and flags a shared enable: false as a manual conflict. Compact MCP input schemas use a portable advertised dialect. #10709 #9354 #11019 #10632. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Reader errors name failed integrity checks and enforced limits. Bridge refusals identify whether the request was sent, and recovery names the relevant control or the next operation for an oversized MCP result. #11052 #11056 #11021 #11119 #11125 #11129 #11505 #11634 #11623 #11133 #11172 #11015 #11777.

Fixes

  • Desktop Evidence retains dconf failures with empty stderr. APT inspection honors disabled deb822 stanzas, uses ASCII separators, preserves tokens and effective identities for one-line sources, and verifies single-stanza identities. Desktop application lookup honors hidden overrides and rejects malformed overrides or desktop group padding before masking IDs. #10230 #10223 #12501 #12498 #12680 #12692 #12711 #12694 #12363 #12675 #12671 #12686 #12708. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Plastic-time, @ShuaixinHuang.

  • Windows shortcut inspection handles pre-epoch timestamps and validates LinkInfo offsets and fixed-size ExtraData blocks. Windows executable discovery uses PATH/PATHEXT, continues past malformed entries, and refuses unresolved objdump or Rizin commands. Headless IDA stdio bounds executable discovery, handles Windows launchers, and retains failed-launch cleanup for retry. #10305 #10303 #12403 #10361 422cff0 #10891 998faa4 #10739. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @wunianze666-netizen.

  • Setup refresh preserves or repairs Hermes and Goose YAML aliases and merge-inherited settings, including inherited stdio transport. MCP records deferred schemas before protocol framing. b138f52 #10430 #9351. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.

  • Finalization keeps cancellation as the primary error when appropriate, captures cancellation during recovered-value publication, and preserves the initial failure after close. Cleanup reports live resources independently of failed closes, retains composite provider clients for retry, and combines provider cleanup failures while retaining their causes. Artifact readers also retain member stream failures during shutdown. 2e1e659 #10645 #12589 #12599 #12591 #12002 #12489 #12487. Thanks @anant8140, @Plastic-time.

  • Browser capture admits relative Playwright trace paths through the CLI, validates large scenario reference lists, retains wide native numeric exclusions, reports capture-script semantic limits, keeps invalid CDP and Playwright response statuses unknown while preserving the trace’s reported status and error, bounds retained network-body verification memory, and speeds up script export conflict detection. 4822082 #10575 #10359 #10343 #10341 #11755 #11565 #12296 #12292 #12231 #12225 #12724. Thanks @chessing234, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @ShuaixinHuang.

  • JavaScript analysis retains large async chunk collections, proven property presence at reads, shared array-iterator prototype effects, projected array dependencies, and lexical ordering across standalone blocks. It preserves uncertainty before initialization and after immutable pattern targets, and fixes V8 code-cache header handling. CommonJS wrapper redeclarations no longer invent application owners. Destructuring retains dependencies across const aliases, inactive defaults, and nested numeric properties. #10362 #12477 #7559 #12493 #12490 #12519 #12558 #12701 #12682 #12673 #10279 #12084 #12513 #12613 #12595. Thanks @coygeek, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @SII-YDD, @XiaoBinGan.

  • ELF readers preserve literal directories in origin expansion, decode 32-bit PRPSINFO values correctly, and retain readable build IDs beside compressed notes. They preserve GNU version slots and dynamic-string diagnostics and distinguish an exhausted string table from a capped scan. ELF admission validates dynamic table framing, section and zlib declarations, interpreter sizes, and dependency table extents, and preserves unwind budget facts. #10215 #10189 #12674 #12685 #12678 #12693 #12445 #12193 #12113 #12344 #12308. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji, @wunianze666-netizen, @XiaoBinGan.

  • PE readers reject out-of-file resource directories before applying the entry budget, validate certificate framing before capacity checks, and bound TLS and export reads to declared section content. GGUF readers reserve framing for fields following metadata values. UEFI extraction accepts the same max_volumes and max_files scan controls as inspection. #10375 #12336 #12432 #12338 #12538.

  • Gradle recognizes metadata via the root version marker, reports unfamiliar format versions, and preserves variant identity. Maven preserves qualified property keys and non-ASCII whitespace in POM version values, and matches declarations in the project namespace. NuGet handles OPC part-name equivalence and rejects invalid manifest relationship target modes. #12488 #12648 #12677 #11860 #12672 #12691 #12684 #12714. Thanks @ShuaixinHuang, @xu91102.

  • Android mapping inspection reports residual signatures without a mapping member. Boot and OTA readers validate boot headers, vendor ramdisk tables, and OTA manifest and signature extents before capacity checks. MIPS inspection identifies unsupported Android relocation declarations. Harmony inspection matches manifests at exact archive-root paths. Deno lockfile inspection retains valid specifiers alongside undecodable rows. #12494 #12396 #12395 #12431 #12397 #12700 #12667.

  • Mach-O parsing validates symbol extents before the hardening scan limit and maps high-backed segments in their declared virtual range. Hopper verifies the Mach-O profile signature before loader selection. ELF and Android OTA share exact-frame Zstandard decoding. #12465 #12479 #12485 #12416 #12398.

  • GPU inspection reports malformed containers as invalid_format and validates standalone PTX encoding during discovery. Core-note reads respect the recorded source range, and PyInstaller and Swift readers check entry framing and vtable bounds before applying capacity ceilings. #10644 #12707 #12634 #12622 #12627.

  • Go SBOM export retains local modules without Package URL namespaces. Managed inspection retains module identity when its name is unreadable. The reference-source importer preserves cancellation during policy-file cleanup, and process capture handles Darwin-helper exit without crashing the host. #12293 #12441 #12323 #11714. Thanks @IvenKooLab.

  • MCP doctor honors output choices on argument errors. Capture image readers validate PNG headers, and trace and keyed-archive errors expose the enforced parser limit. Sigrok catalog scans retain selected decoder rows only. The documentation site resolves authored links to their published routes. #2693 #12310 #12335 #12324 #12284 #12453. Thanks @jasonchen505.

⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

  • Evidence records and hand-built bundles require evidence_format: 2. Recreate older observations, bundles, and snapshots with 6.10. Re-exporting old observations does not update their identities. Read subject.identity in place of subject.digest, subject.format, and subject.architecture (file identities use sha256). Every record has a subject, using an explicit unknown identity when appropriate. Identity, including an artifact's selection, participates in Evidence IDs. Recreate 6.7-era artifact summaries before using compare_artifacts. #11416 #10861.
  • Snapshots use target: {kind, identity} and a non-null execution.subject: {identity, name, local_path}. Binding errors use the same target shape. Universal Mach-O Evidence IDs include the selected slice. Live page tools and their views use a {kind: "url", url, origin} identity with credentials removed, null origin for opaque URLs, and null subject name and local path. Withheld or unreadable URLs retain an unknown identity. Recreate affected Evidence and snapshots. #11551 PR 11559.
  • Process captures require manifest.root_process. Their subject identity is {kind: "process", pid, start_time, executable_sha256} when observed, {kind: "unknown", reason: "not-observed"} when the start identity could not be read, and {kind: "unknown", reason: "withheld-by-caller"} when PID normalization is enabled. Accept cleanup_outcome: "cleaned" on quiesced settlements. Recreate saved process Evidence. Existing omission semantics still apply: raw_data is omitted when it equals data, and residual_unknowns is omitted when there are none. #11568 #10481 #8032 #10956. Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @N0zoM1z0, @Rinkia, @wunianze666-netizen.
  • Rizin command Evidence and GDB startup and console Evidence use {kind: "session", session_kind, id, target}. The session target identifies the initial launch file when REA can observe it. GDB accepts an optional executable. Without one, or when the file identity could not be observed, the target is unknown with reason not-observed. The binding describes the launch file only. The current inferior's identity requires a separate observation. Recreate debugger Evidence because its IDs change. PR 11570 PR 11572 230db70 #11710 #11581. Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Ghidra and Hopper profiles replace hand-bumped markers with analysis_profile.parameters.producer containing rea_version and sources_sha256. Ghidra drops bridge_sources_sha256 and version suffixes on selection values. Hopper drops function_dossier_coverage. Profiles and Evidence IDs change. Open the target and save a fresh snapshot. #11320.
  • Ghidra requires a supported 12.x build starting at 12.2 and a JDK within that build's declared range (25 or newer for the verified 12.2 build). For a DOS COM file accepted by ComLoader, read the reported load_address (now linear 0x100). The BinaryLoader fallback still uses 1000:0100. #12081 #12086.
  • IDA attached registrations must explicitly set "protocol": "native" and use the native plugin endpoint for an open GUI database. Migrate legacy 1.4 proxy registrations to that mode or to an ida-pro-mcp 2.x supervisor in headless mode. procedure_callers is removed from IDA profiles, and IDA assembly/instruction tools drop the may_show_ui annotation. #10846 #11546 #10516.
  • Use rea mcp or rea --mcp in place of rea <command> --mcp. Regenerate shell hooks with rea completions <shell> and update Markdown argument-diagnostic snapshots for the new rendering. Flag-shaped unknown MCP subcommands honor the selected output format. 7d502dd #11724 62014b5 #11742 #10583 #11654. Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @N0zoM1z0.
  • MCP rejects full input and output schema profiles. Remove those settings or select compact. An unset REA_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE now means off; set it to compact to receive tools/list[].outputSchema. MCP limit errors omit details.limit.cli_flag; the CLI still supplies its own flag when applicable. #10693 #11413.
  • Use absolute local paths in MCP calls to inspect_pcap_capture, start_rizin_debug_session, start_gdb_session (including inferior_tty), load_frida_script, and instrument_with_frida. CLI --script-file still accepts a relative path and records the resolved absolute source_path. #11508 #11079 #11580 #11506.
  • Native rea analyze rejects JavaScript-only options such as --integrity-policy with invalid_request naming the flag. Pass those options only for JavaScript targets. For inspect-managed-members --detail summary, rename --evidence-bundle <path> to --evidence_output <path> and read .summary and .evidence_bundle in stdout. Publication failures use the shared error shape. Composite CLI failures such as those from compare-managed-members can carry completed inputs as details.argument_observations[] entries with {argument, observation}. PR 10808 PR 10845 PR 10961.
  • For a missing, unreadable, or non-regular target-selected plist, decode target_unavailable with details.path and reason in place of invalid_request with input issues. Open a plist outside the current app bundle or resource root as a separate target. #9754 #10798. Thanks @Anandumv.
  • In Cutter JSON command output, integers beyond JavaScript's safe range are decimal strings. Parse them with a lossless integer type. Cutter's output_truncated and document_generation may be null. Treat truncation as unknown and list sessions again before choosing expected_generation. GDB MI decodes \e to ESC instead of rejecting the record. #12457 #10726.
  • ADB package output preserves whitespace in version_name. Decode numeric_issues and coverage; malformed versionCode and user_id declarations make coverage partial. For a malformed version token such as 45abc, expect a version_code issue with reason invalid_format, an increased issue total, and a null version code unless a later valid declaration supplies it. 1adc3fa #10519 #7123 #7271 #7281 #7388 #7409 #7534 #7692 #8067 #8141 #8302 #9195 #10172 #10389. Thanks @1052326311, @2SinceJuly, @carcraze, @coygeek, @deepakrakshit, @Eldergenix, @gensokyo-dev, @HeadmasterEggy, @Hiba-Malik, @kittimzhe, @mawahnnie, @N0zoM1z0, @Rinkia, @saariuslystoned, @ShuaixinHuang, @sx4im, @theo-73, @wunianze666-netizen.
  • Update coverage decoders for native initializers and kernel build configs to accept partial for observed but incomplete coverage and unknown when completeness could not be established. ELF unwind ranges use partial in place of incomplete, and capped model metadata arrays use partial in place of preview. #11483 #11486 #11463 #11469.
  • Managed member comparison uses tagged objects in limitations[]; read code and side in place of limitation_reasons or message prefixes. Recreate managed observations. Supply explicit nullable assembly, boolean nesting_read, and signature_resolution as "type-names-v2" or null. Null is only valid without examined members, references, call edges, or field accesses. The historical bare-name comparison mode is removed. Call edges and field accesses require target_row_resolved. #11177 #10952 #11334 PR 10992.
  • Recreate JavaScript and Electron captures missing runtime scripts.parse_failed_total or active Electron parameters.resolved_paths. Application analysis requires statistics.skipped_javascript_files and summary.protocol_registrations. Original-source and module-edge links require source_index and declaration_index. #10958 #10990.
  • Recreate browser captures using the current producers. Source-map items require effective_url, invalid maps require response_identity, and mapping rows require source_index and declaration_index. WebMCP declarations require schema_property_names_coverage. Storage results require content_fingerprints, fingerprint_algorithm, and fingerprints_complete; IndexedDB schema fingerprints require projection_version: 2. Link rows require context_url and context_scope. PR 10991 PR 11002.
  • Browser page inspections require accessibility states, script frame_id, and worker opener_target_id and parent_frame_id. Web-bundle captures require capture.target_origin. Scenario network rows with a null redirect predecessor require redirected_from_transaction_state. In page network requests, include redirects: [] when there are no redirects. DOM snapshots require node_value_length_unit, and redirect timeline rows require redirect_response. Recreate captures before comparing them, including inline inspections. Re-import reference sources so every exclusions[] row carries entry_kind, using the explicit unknown kind where applicable. #11344 PR 11014 PR 10897.
  • Recreate PCAP Evidence with dns_queries[].query_labels_hex and explicit tshark/capinfos identity fields. Recreate desktop state Evidence with effective_view_policy.sqlite_view_bytes, SQLite Evidence with worker_timeout_ms, and Dart AOT Evidence with string_pool.policy. PR 10879 PR 10886.
  • Recreate Android packages, component views, and reference observations with component declaration facets, target_definition, and direct_invokes_coverage. Declaration coverage and counts drop unknown; manifest views declare facet: "manifest". JNI failures with kind integrity require integrity_check. #11624 PR 10904.
  • Recreate native Evidence for Mach-O encryption, malformed slice causes, import facts and symbol runtime_name; ELF import/export encoding and export visibility; value-flow limits; load-image permissions and relocation symbols; Swift type_reference_kind; and GPU amd_target_metadata. Update strict readers for removed legacy values such as unknown ELF export visibility and modinfo_field_exceeds_limit. PR 10946.
  • Recreate inventory Evidence missing ESP format_metadata.flash_dump, PE signer observations missing unsigned_attribute_oids, and firmware inspection or extraction results missing analysis_timeout_ms. #11595.

Full contribution record: 1589 commits and 1383 merged PRs.

Highlights

  • Inspect and extract UEFI firmware volumes, files, and AMI NVRAM with three offline CLI and MCP tools. #12342. Thanks @bartman081523.

  • Evidence revision 2 gives file, process, debugger, and browser observations explicit subject identities. See the migration details below.
  • The verified Ghidra 12.2 lane opens recognized DOS COM files and supports more RISC-V, MIPS32, and PowerPC64 ELF targets. #4811 #4487 #2362 #2338 #12517 #12085. Thanks @abhay-2108, @AurelioB, @Davmunrey, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @Rinkia.

Changes

  • JavaScript semantic indexing uses fixed object shapes for nested evaluation contexts to reduce allocation overhead. #9007. Thanks @mshzy.
  • Inspect ELF dynamic dependencies and required symbol versions, resolve separate debug-file linkage, inspect DWARF compilation units offline, and decode FDO packaging and dlopen notes. e9c72db #7868 54e3918 #9560 637e4cb #8523 #7237 #7235. Thanks @AniketR10, @gensokyo-dev, @mvanhorn.
  • Read cargo-auditable dependencies from WebAssembly and export Go and Rust dependency Evidence as CycloneDX. #5069 237b1ea #8445. Thanks @gensokyo-dev, @kaoru0822-kitauji, @mvanhorn, @yu0809.
  • Decode CPython 3.14 and 3.15 bytecode and use Kuna 1.1000. 1d08253 #10518 #12107. Thanks @abhisheksharma001, @gensokyo-dev, @N0zoM1z0.
  • Managed member inspection retains unresolved_definitions and summarizes unresolved definition coordinates. Native inspection surfaces prototype instruction conflicts, resolves RISC-V initializer pointers, and identifies which Mach-O slices a signature covers. #12462 #8161 #1244 #12109 #11620. Thanks @akshad-exe, @N0zoM1z0, @ShuaixinHuang.
  • GDB and Rizin explain why stopped sessions reject commands and why a debugger stop or close could not finish. #11652 #11517 #11185.
  • Setup manages fx, Junie, Goose, and Kilo registrations, supports explicit MCP catalog profile selection, and flags a shared enable: false as a manual conflict. Compact MCP input schemas use a portable advertised dialect. #10709 #9354 #11019 #10632. Thanks @kaoru0822-kitauji.
  • Reader errors name failed integrity checks and enforced limits. Bridge refusals identify whether the request was sent, and recovery names the relevant control or the next operation for an oversized MCP result. #11052 #11056 #11021 #11119 #11125 #11129 #11505 #11634 #11623 #11133 #11172 #11015 #11777.

  • Desktop Evidence retains dconf failures with empty stderr. APT inspection honors disabled deb822 stanzas, uses ASCII separators, preserves tokens and effective identities for one-line sources, and verifies single-stanza identities. Desktop application lookup honors hidden overrides and rejects malformed overrides or desktop group padding before masking IDs. #10230 #10223 #12501 #12498 #12680 #12692 #12711 #12694 #12363 #12675 #12671 #12686 #12708. Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

v0.9.72 Stable2026-11-20T04:01:26Z

HyperFrames v0.9.72

Released on 2026-11-20.

Renders limited by a CPU quota, such as a Kubernetes CPU limit, get their workers back, so long renders run at full speed again. Sealed previews restack layers from the layers panel and the timeline, and their videos keep colour grading and audio effects.

Fixes

  • Engine: Renders under a CPU quota get their workers back (db5950c00, #8262).
  • Studio: Dragging a layer in a sealed preview's layers panel restacks it (9c3bfe150, #8209).
  • Core: A sealed preview's own videos load with CORS, so colour grading and audio effects work (7b3eda190, #8189).
  • CLI: Describe the sign-in return test in plain words (c28cda322, #8259).
  • Media Use: Escape audio engine summary and broken audio_meta.json errors (4a11e46c7, #8258).
  • Studio: Save the stacking reorder of a timeline drag in a sealed preview (9dd8be3ac, #8167).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Give the 9:16 safe band that check enforces (bcb2dd031, #8261).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.71...v0.9.72

v0.9.71 Stable2026-11-19T22:48:02Z

HyperFrames v0.9.71

Released on 2026-11-19.

Cancelling a render now stops its compile, and files a compile downloads have a size cap and one shared deadline. Renders read frames from MP4s whose seek index leaves out the first keyframe, and SVG-heavy compositions stay within the compile size limit.

Fixes

  • Engine: Extract frames from MP4s whose seek index leaves out the first keyframe (9813a6cbe, #8252).
  • Media Use: Duck, cut, transcribe, dither and audio scripts print control characters as escapes (98f548447, #8235).
  • Core: Attribute-value escapes write '<' so style text can't end early (9e7835367, #8250).
  • Media Use: Provider error lines print control characters as escapes (77134c927, #8249).
  • Core: Keep SVG selector alias growth within the compile budget (6bd0b5d87, #8238).
  • Lint: Read a media window's start through the parser (a7d7a6075, #8133).
  • Producer: Cancelling a render stops its compile (765883195, #8242).
  • Producer: Cap compile-time remote downloads, give them one deadline and stop them on cancel (77ea9d80c, #8195).
  • Core: Stop crashing on SVG elements named template (d106f9c8c, #8241).
  • Core: Read selector aliases only from what the compiler wrote (def770ed9, #8240).
  • Core: Page runtimes carry no wide characters, so pages stay one byte a char (01a5e948b, #8239).
  • Media Use: Re-freezing a recipe archives only under an integer version (e383abf47, #8201).

Docs & Examples

  • Adopters: Add ViralMint (78d8ad037, #7738).

Catalog

  • CLI: Report an empty catalog --type= as a usage error (c2911adc8, #8130).

Internal

  • CLI: The phone-clip offload tests pass when run together (3f3a6205a, #8071).

Full changelog

v2.14.17v2.14.17 — marketing-loops (1.8.4 → 1.9.0): a new reply-fed expansion loop in the Outbound group, 6… Stable2026-11-19T22:52:40Z
  • marketing-loops (1.8.4 → 1.9.0): a new reply-fed expansion loop in the Outbound group, 61 loops in all (#997). Monthly, once about 30 positive replies have built up, it enriches the repliers, sets each trait's share of positive replies against its share of sends, groups the over-represented traits into two to four micro-segments, sources lookalike accounts for each, and stages the new segments for approval. It stops when there are too few replies or no trait stands out, never re-adds anyone who opted out or got a breakup email, and tags expansion segments so the sequence-retro loop reports them separately. The outbound operator's schedule lists it. Eval 10 added. Adapted from Julien Lieben's autoresearch loop playbook (ColdIQ).

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Fixed

  • Fixed GIF images failing Liquid AI judgments with HTTP 422; they are now sent as PNG (#19757 by @alphastorm)
  • Anthropic strict-tool fallback now treats a Vertex org-policy rejection of structured_outputs (allowedPartnerModelFeatures / "disallowed feature structured_outputs") as a strict-tools rejection, retries once without strict, and pins strictToolsDisabled (#19576) (#19655 by @koeria)
  • Kiro requests rejected with Input is too long. or CONTENT_LENGTH_EXCEEDS_THRESHOLD can now recover through conversation compaction (#19723 by @emotionbug)
  • Kiro thinking off now turns reasoning off instead of running the model's default effort; models that cannot disable reasoning use their lowest effort (#19722 by @emotionbug)
  • Kiro /usage shows purchased add-on credits, and an account whose plan credits are spent keeps serving while add-on credits remain (#19724 by @emotionbug)
  • Kiro Identity Center logins in AWS GovCloud (US) now list profiles in us-gov-west-1 and us-gov-east-1 instead of the commercial regions, which reject GovCloud tokens (#19726 by @TechDufus)
  • Statusless gateway errors reading stream interrupted now retry like stream was interrupted instead of ending the turn (#19709).

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Fixed

  • The browser relay extension survives a browser whose loaded permission set predates the downloads permission: the service worker keeps working without download pairing instead of crashing before it ever connects (#19659 by @pavel-kalmykov)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added

  • Added Liquid AI's d1.2 and d1.2-ultra judge models; liquid now defaults to d1.2 (#19753 by @alphastorm)
  • Added gemini-4-neon to the bundled Antigravity CLI roster, with the low/medium/high/xhigh thought levels agy offers for it (#19787 by @ataberkus).
  • Model.snapcompactShape ({ variant, frameSize? }) gives a model its own snapcompact frame shape (#19591 by @ryanskidmore)

Fixed

  • Discovered Kiro models that cannot turn reasoning off now use their lowest supported effort when thinking is set to off (#19722 by @emotionbug)
  • Kiro accepts AWS GovCloud (US) profile ARNs (arn:aws-us-gov:codewhisperer:…), which were previously skipped during profile listing (#19726 by @TechDufus)
  • Google Antigravity no longer lists Gemini 4 Hydrogen's sonar monitor slot or its tiered High/XHigh SKUs as separate models; the tiered SKUs fold into the one Gemini 4 Hydrogen model (#19795 by @eggpeat)
  • Gemini 4 Neon on Google Antigravity now shows as one model whose thinking level (low, medium, high, xhigh) selects the matching SKU, instead of four separate models, and is priced at $3/$15 per million tokens ($0.15 cached) instead of $0 (#19789 by @eggpeat)
  • Gemini 4 Neon now collapses into one model on Gemini CLI too, and on the Gemini API and Vertex AI offers the xhigh thinking level and long outputs up to 262,144 tokens, with its $3/$15 Gemini API price

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • /session shows the path of the session's local:// directory, and /copy local copies it, creating the directory first so it can be entered before anything was written there (#19778 by @farnoy)
  • snapcompactShape on models.yml models, modelOverrides and extension registerProvider models sets that model's snapcompact frame shape (#19591 by @ryanskidmore)

Fixed

  • Fixed PTY command transcripts sometimes gaining a blank line where a \r\n line ending was split across two terminal reads.
  • Fixed the shell's dirname builtin on Windows ignoring \ separators and drive prefixes (dirname 'C:\a\b' printed .), which broke scripts like VS Code's code launcher (./Code.exe: No such file or directory)
  • Fixed bash output minimizing being skipped on Windows when a command is named by a \ path or with .exe ("C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe" status, git.exe log)
  • Fixed the bundled omp://tools docs still describing the removed ida tool; tools/dsm.md now documents eval's dsm namespace and disassembler.* settings, and tools/read.md documents metadata-only executable reads (#19608)
  • Fixed native terminal hosts such as Tern placing extension aboveEditor widgets and a blank row between the status row and the tray; the widgets now sit above the status row (#19767)
  • Fixed ^model mentions in queued messages (->/=> while the agent is busy, later items of a numbered list, RPC steer/follow_up, ACP steering) reaching the model as literal ^provider/model text instead of registering their m<N> agent (#19683 by @a-glapinski)
  • Fixed ^model mentions in extension messages sent with sendUserMessage({ deliverAs: "steer" | "followUp" | "aside" }) while the agent is busy reaching the model as literal text (#19799 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed every message queued behind an undelivered ^model mention repeating the "m<N> now available" notice to the model (#19799 by @H4vC)
  • A plugin manifest with a non-string extensions entry (e.g. an object) no longer crashes extension loading with ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE; the entry is reported as not found and valid entries still load (#19674 by @koeria)
  • Fixed embedded bash script.sh resolving BASH_SOURCE[0] to bash instead of the script path, which broke scripts loading files beside themselves (#19792)
  • Fixed proxy model discovery ignoring a gateway's advertised input modalities and output-token cap (#19754 by @zhyc9de).
  • Fixed a provider routed through an auth gateway (transport: pi-native in models.yml) still listing models from the provider's own endpoint, sending the gateway key there; such providers now skip the provider's model discovery and keep their bundled and cached models (#19646 by @ray8828)
  • Fixed a spurious "cache miss" marker on the first turn after a compaction: compaction rewrites the prompt prefix, so that miss is expected and no longer flagged (#19679 by @Petyok)
  • Fixed omp --resume <id> under --mode rpc, --mode rpc-ui and --mode acp failing at start when the session's directory no longer exists; the session now opens where it is stored, with the launch directory as its working directory, without asking whether to move it (#19651 by @sjawhar)
  • Fixed the browser relay extension dying silently in a browser whose loaded permission set predates the downloads permission: it now keeps working without download pairing, and the relay reports a download tracking gap instead of a generic not-found (#19659 by @pavel-kalmykov)
  • Sharing a session whose subagents report progress faster than the uplink drains no longer ends with "collab send backlog exceeded its limit" while a guest joins
  • Fixed /loop iterations and /goal continuations firing ~800ms after a turn yields to wait on background subagents or jobs; they now wait until the run finishes (#19781)

Fission-AI/OpenSpec ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v2.1.1v2.1.1 - Offline skill installs, safer archive Stable2026-11-19T22:26:58Z

OpenSpec 2.1.1

This release smooths out a handful of rough edges. Skills now install straight from the CLI, with no Git and no network needed. Archive is more careful with your main specs, and validate --strict catches two problems before they reach archive. Your workflows don't change.

How to upgrade

Update the OpenSpec CLI, then run this in each project:

openspec update

Skills install from the CLI itself

  • No more Git or GitHub needed to install skills. In 2.1.0, openspec init and openspec update cloned the skills from GitHub, so they failed without Git, behind a strict firewall, or offline. The skills now come from the CLI package you already installed, so setup works anywhere and the skills always match your CLI version.
  • npx skills add installs stay up to date. If you added the OpenSpec skills to a project with npx skills add, openspec update used to skip them. It now finds them and refreshes them like any other install.
  • The continue workflow hands off to apply again. When planning is complete, the continue skill tells you the plan is ready to review and that you can ask your agent to apply it.

Archive is safer with your specs

  • Archive won't half-finish. If the archive folder for a change already exists, the archive workflow now stops before it touches any main spec. Before, it could update your main specs and then fail, leaving them out of step with the archive.
  • New main specs come out formatted. When archive creates a main spec, it puts a blank line after ## Purpose, so the file passes Prettier and markdownlint without a reformat.
  • Retiring a capability reads wrapped lines correctly. A requirement line that wraps onto a line starting with <, like <args> are passed on to the script, used to be read as stray HTML and block the retirement. It's now read as part of the sentence.

Validate catches more, earlier

  • Frontmatter at the top of a delta spec is allowed. openspec validate --strict no longer fails on a delta spec that starts with a YAML frontmatter block.
  • Overlong edits are flagged before archive. When a MODIFIED requirement grows past the 500-character limit, validate --strict now warns you, so you can trim it while you're still working on the change.

Upgrade advice that fits your install

  • Homebrew and Nix users get the right update command. openspec version --check and openspec update used to tell every install to run npm install -g, and even offered to run it. A Homebrew install is now told to run brew upgrade openspec, and a Nix install is no longer told to use npm.

Full changelog: v2.1.0...v2.1.1

  • Fix: ruby methods of one class or module whose names differ only by a leading/trailing _ or by case (_read_attribute/read_attribute, _where!/where!), including those in a class << self, get distinct node ids instead of one swallowing the other (#5292, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
  • Fix: lua table-field functions whose names differ only by a leading/trailing _ (M._load/M.load, Runner:_start/Runner:start) get distinct node ids; M.f/M:f still name one field (#5294, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
  • Fix: scala members whose names differ only by a leading _, a _= setter suffix, or case (_enter/enter, size/size_=, forEach/foreach), including across a class and its companion object, get distinct node ids (#5296, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
  • Fix: elixir defs whose names differ only by a leading/trailing _, a !/? suffix, or case (_name/name, get/get!, __schema__/schema) get distinct node ids, so a get! call no longer lands on get (#5298, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
  • Fix: rust a prelude trait's type argument (Celsius in impl From<Celsius> or a T: Into<Celsius> bound) is read as a generic-argument reference instead of being mistaken for the trait itself, so it no longer emits a wrong implements/inherits edge (#5332, thanks @azeemshaik025).
  • Fix: go a member call is kept when another package in the corpus names a sibling-file type: the colliding sourceless stub is moved to its own id instead of salting the real declaration and orphaning its method edges, which had dropped the call (#5304, thanks @Yi-111-a).
  • Fix: ruby a method written inline after an access modifier (private def validate, private_class_method def self.audit) keeps its membership of the enclosing class instead of being emitted as a file-level function, so calls to it resolve to the method (#5310, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: swift a call that is the last operand of an operator expression (base + bonus(), !isEmpty()), which the grammar parses as the callee, is extracted instead of dropped (#5311, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: kotlin a call under a prefix operator (!isReady(), -compute()) is extracted instead of dropped, including stacked prefixes and !obj.ready() (#5312, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: vbnet a parameter with a default value is counted as Optional regardless of modifier order (ByVal Optional x As Integer = 0, ByRef Optional ...), so method arity and overload resolution are correct (#5320, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Fix: cpp include identities are kept when the AST cache is on another drive than the source (a Windows cross-drive case where os.path.relpath raised and every file got an empty key), so declaration/definition folding still works; the normal same-drive path is unchanged (#5145, thanks @Ayushraj06-bit).
  • Fix: llm label-generation retries keep a 512-token output floor, so the single-community recovery pass is no longer starved below the batch it is recovering from; an explicit GRAPHIFY_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS still overrides (#2086, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: ruby an include/prepend/extend of a module written inside a class << self block emits its mixes_in edge, instead of being missed because only direct class-body statements were scanned (#5317, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: python a class with a parameterized base (class C(Base[T]), class D(Mapping[str, int])) emits the inherits edge to the base type and is walked for inherited-method calls, instead of being dropped and marked opaque; a nested generic argument, a call base, and mod.Base[T] are still not treated as parents (#5318, thanks @Synvoya).
  • Fix: tsconfig a tsconfig.json extends and exact compilerOptions.paths mapping resolve to the real scanned config/file they name rather than a dangling stub; a non-corpus package extends, a wildcard path, and a circular extends fail closed (#5223, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
  • Fix: cpp an unreachable class forward declaration (one no include path reaches) no longer blocks the fold of a member's declaration into its out-of-line definition; genuinely ambiguous cases (a template or a second definition) still stay separate (#5337, thanks @winesoft-namjin-yun).
  • Fix: extract an import that targets a header involved in an id collision is no longer unconditionally repointed to the header variant: the repoint is gated by the importing file's language family, so a Python import foo beside a colliding foo.h/foo.py keeps its edge to foo.py instead of being dropped as cross-language (#5328, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
  • Fix: serve a query that is an exact node id resolves straight to that node instead of being out-ranked by a different node that shares its tokenized source path (#5343, thanks @Ayushraj06-bit).

The AST cache schema is bumped to 49; warm caches re-run the affected Ruby, Lua, Scala, Elixir, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, VB.NET, Python and TypeScript-config extractions.

v0.9.3Skill Recorder v0.9.3 Stable2026-11-19T20:52:17Z

Commit-pinned installation

Copy the complete command for your operating system into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (macOS/Ubuntu). Use the same command to install or update.

Windows 11 x64 or ARM64

$commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; $env:SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT=$commit; irm "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.ps1" | iex

Windows finishes installation without automatically opening the app. Finish any recording, choose Quit in all running Skill Recorder copies, then open Skill Recorder (Source) from the desktop or Start menu. Follow the completion notice if a manual launch command is needed.

macOS or Ubuntu

Quit older running copies before updating, then run:

commit="0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a"; curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/skill-recorder/$commit/install.sh" | SKILL_RECORDER_COMMIT="$commit" bash

For script inspection and hash verification before execution, use the inspect-first instructions.

Fixes

  • Recover fresh installations blocked by ONNX Runtime license-download failures. If the pinned upstream legal-file URLs are unavailable, installation reports the failure and tries explicit version-pinned jsDelivr recovery URLs.
  • Preserve license verification. Every recovered license and notice must match its existing reviewed SHA-256. Original source references and approved hashes are unchanged; mismatched content and HTML error pages are rejected.
  • Retain recovery alternatives in REMOTE-MATERIALS.json, document recovery behavior, and add regression coverage for upstream failure, cache verification, recovery failure, and invalid content.

Upgrade and compatibility

  • This is a compatible patch release. Application dependency versions and existing compliance approvals are unchanged.
  • Commands pinned to 63bbb50111713b02f3bc0ebbd5f354f4eb038f99 (0.9.2) retain the old behavior. Use the complete command above to obtain the fix; rerunning the old command will not update it.
  • Recovery downloads require access to cdn.jsdelivr.net when the original upstream is unavailable. Verification is never bypassed if neither source is accessible.
  • Recordings and application data remain in their existing locations.

Source-only release

Skill Recorder 0.9.3 is published from commit 0d4bd217aad1fb349cc1e4b1a0ff3fd8cce5e70a.

This release is source-only. No installers or portable binaries are attached. GitHub's generated archives contain the tagged repository source only, not dependencies or downloaded runtimes. Locally assembled source builds are not redistributable release binaries.

Validation

  • 49 local compliance and Windows dependency-installer tests passed.
  • All six ONNX license/notice materials were retrieved through actual upstream failures and recovery downloads, matching their existing reviewed SHA-256 values and expected legal-text markers.
  • Lockfile portability passed; every pre-existing compliance-policy entry was verified unchanged.
  • Evaluation TypeScript checks passed.
  • Exact release-commit CI passed on Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS/Ubuntu, covering commit-pinned source installation, license/compliance checks, tests, builds, BYOM runtime transport, and applicable packaging/architecture checks.

Installer script SHA-256

These hashes were calculated from the exact release commit's Git blobs.

bd8b5200a2c140c5a5ed9299d565ac72cee5420181774008977eaf75f210db1d  install.sh

alam00000/bentopdf ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v2.8.12Sort and nginx fix - v2.8.12 Stable2026-11-19T17:42:56Z

[!WARNING] Docker images now ship nginx 1.31.9, which fixes the ten nginx CVEs published on Nov 18, 2026 (including CVE-2026-123007) affecting all versions up to and including v2.8.11.

These are not BentoPDF CVEs. They are in nginx, the web server inside our Docker image, and the default BentoPDF setup does not use any of the affected features (HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS, mail, stream, proxying). However, anyone whose setup matches the conditions described in those CVEs is at risk, for example if you changed the nginx config inside the container. So I decided it was better to ship a release with the fixed nginx than to leave it. All users are strongly advised to upgrade to v2.8.12 immediately.

New

  • Sort your file lists by name, modified date or size, ascending or descending. Works in Merge PDF, Alternate Merge, and the image and text to PDF tools.
  • Top bar buttons now show hover text when their labels are hidden. Thanks @AB527.

Fixes

  • Validate Signature now detects and verifies document timestamps, and flags weak ones. Thanks @AB527.
  • Workflows: pages with JPEG2000 images no longer render blank, and the Remove Blank Pages node works again.
  • Polish is now detected correctly as a language. Thanks @atpanos for their first contribution.

To update: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d

Full Changelog: https://github.com/alam00000/bentopdf/compare/v2.8.11...v2.8.12

New Contributors

v2026.11.10-beta.1openclaw 2026.11.10-beta.1 Prerelease2026-11-19T15:45:29Z

2026.11.10-beta.1

Highlights

  • Agent templates: add agents directly from ClawHub packages, with a single CLAW.md manifest and bundled skill folders checked by the native trust flow. (#195707, #196322, #196348) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • OpenClaw ID: connect nodes through the ID tunnel, approve them from Access, and link owner devices to your own identity. (#193982, #194007, #197628) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Browser handoff: take over the agent’s browser directly from the Browser panel without stopping the agent. (#197928) Related #197902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Chat control: send pending steering messages without stopping a run, edit queued messages, and retain composer drafts across app restarts. (#193665, #197846, #197908) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
  • Updates: configure automatic update schedules and let the incoming release run its own pre-update rehearsal. (#193713, #197922) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • State upgrades: migrate Gateway state using copy-and-swap at startup rather than modifying the live store in place. (#198389) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Durable execution: keep background commands running across Gateway restarts on macOS. (#197474) Related #197443 Thanks @daniel-lxs.

Changes

  • Access: add a guest member role with sandboxed session tools. (#197748) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Tool discovery: offer an opt-in usage-ranked tool index, including MCP tools. (#197128, #198348) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Knowledge: find current records when searches use wording from their superseded versions. (#193742) Related #193054 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Voice and images: choose the speech-to-text model in Settings → Talk, and let agents review generated images before delivery. (#197906, #198227) Related #197859 Thanks @daniel-lxs and @vincentkoc.
  • Providers: support Parallel Decisions both natively and through OpenRouter. (#194537) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Backups: show stage and byte progress during long-running backups. (#198675) Thanks @vincentkoc.

Fixes

  • Access boundaries: apply OpenClaw ID member permissions consistently to HTTP history and connected-app panels. (#199946, #200070) Thanks @joshavant.
  • Queued input: show a visible withheld failure when permission is revoked instead of silently canceling the message. (#200213) Thanks @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @obviyus.
  • Subagents: retain results through Gateway restarts and retry completion delivery after the requester is interrupted. (#199868, #200165) Authored by @steipete.
  • OpenAI responses: recover item conflicts across runs and complete replay-safe turns after deferred conflict recovery. (#199896, #200254) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT and @obviyus.
  • Slack delivery: preserve the final reply when native streams hit a boundary or message-length limit, and keep expired progress from appearing after the answer. (#199849, #200080) Related #200045 Thanks @n1hility, @obviyus, and @atlas-kring.
  • Discord: render edited messages consistently with new sends while preserving literal user-mention tokens inside code. (#199958, #200053) Related #190479, #195585 Thanks @obviyus, @yetval, and @saariuslystoned.
  • Signal: preserve native mention recipients in quoted messages. (#200058) Related #195074 Thanks @obviyus and @saariuslystoned.
  • Chat history: preserve reading position when transcript ranges shrink, load older history after interrupted restoration, and retain pasted text if the clipboard changes mid-paste. (#199747, #200107, #200098) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
  • Usage display: stop presenting fully unpriced usage as a known zero-dollar cost. (#199711) Related #199710 Thanks @JoshSalomon and @obviyus.
  • Update recovery: restrict startup copies and pruning to owned state and preserve successful startup writes for the next Doctor run. (#199929, #200260) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Responsiveness: reduce cold-session compaction CPU and latency regressions, prepare large histories outside the Gateway thread, and shorten write locks during large Knowledge vault scans. (#199561, #200114, #199859) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.

Complete contribution record

The full contribution record is available in the tag-pinned CHANGELOG.md.

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.36CC Switch v4.0.36 Stable2026-11-19T15:00:32Z

CC Switch v4.0.36

本版本新增插件页面，可以在 CC Switch 里安装、启用、更新、卸载 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、MiniMax Code、OpenClaw、Pi 的插件，并管理 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 的插件市场。技能仓库现在可以用访问令牌读取私有仓库；经本地路由的供应商可以设置费用倍率；会话管理里能看到 Claude Code 桌面版的章节。

另外修复了 Codex 开了官方额度保护后自动审批也被拦下；Codex 聚合模式下新发布的官方模型要很久才出现；OpenCode 升级到 2.x 后 1.x 会话的用量不再统计；用量页自定义日期一输入年份就变成 1905；Antigravity 多个模型显示未定价等问题。用量统计里价格相同的推理档位现在合并成一行。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

插件页面

侧栏新增「插件」，通过各应用自己的命令行管理插件（需求见 #791，#9220）：

  • 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、MiniMax Code、OpenClaw、Pi，只列出没有隐藏的应用。
  • 「已安装」里可以启用、停用、更新（MiniMax Code 不能更新）、卸载；「发现」里搜索并安装；Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 还可以在「市场」里添加、刷新、移除插件市场，地址可以是 GitHub 的 owner/repo、Git 地址或本地文件夹。Pi 的插件来自 npm 上的 Pi 包。
  • Grok Build、OpenClaw、Pi 安装前会先确认：插件以你的权限运行，只装来源可信的。Claude Code 里要在终端同意的插件，CC Switch 不替你同意，会提示到终端运行对应的安装命令；需要先登录的应用也会提示登录命令。
  • Codex 停用插件只改 config.toml 里这个插件的 enabled，其余内容和注释不动。
  • 大的市场仓库下载可能要几分钟，可以先关掉对话框，完成后会提示。

技能仓库支持私有仓库

「管理技能仓库」里可以按站点设置访问令牌，GitHub、GitLab、Gitea / Forgejo 上的私有仓库都能浏览、安装和检查更新（需求见 #9666）。

  • 令牌按站点保存（如 github.com、gitlab.example.com），存在系统的凭据存储里（macOS 钥匙串、Windows 凭据管理器，其他系统是本机仅自己可读的文件），不随云同步。只需要只读权限。
  • 下载失败时会区分是没设令牌，还是令牌被拒（无效、过期或无权读取这个仓库）。

供应商费用倍率

中转按折扣计费时，用量统计里的花费可以按倍率估算（#9656）。Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 的非官方供应商表单里新增「供应商费用倍率」：这家所有模型的参考价都乘以它，0.5 即半价，留空为 1 倍。

  • 只对经本地路由、并且设置之后的请求生效；直连时从会话记录导入的用量仍按 1 倍统计。

会话管理里显示 Claude Code 桌面版的章节

Claude Code 桌面版里模型给对话打的章节，以前显示成普通的 MCP 工具调用（需求见 #9728，#9729）。现在显示成章节行，收起时间线也能看到；对话目录里会列出章节，点击即跳转；查找能搜到章节，导出 Markdown 时章节变成标题。

变更

  • 用量统计合并价格相同的推理档位（#8845，见 #9065）：同一个模型的不同推理强度，如果输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写四种价格都和基础模型相同，并且基础模型有精确价格，就合并到基础模型那一行。筛选、每日汇总和首字时间都按合并后统计，请求日志里仍显示原始模型名。

修复

  • Codex 开了「官方额度保护」后，达到阈值时自动审批也被拦下（#9733，见 #9732）：OpenAI 已经让 Codex 的自动审批模型 codex-auto-review 免费、不计入套餐额度，现在额度保护对它直接放行，其他官方模型照常暂停。
  • Codex 聚合模式下，新发布的官方模型（如 GPT-6.2）要很久才出现：聚合模式下 Codex 只读 CC Switch 写的模型目录。官方模型列表的缓存从 6 小时缩短到 1 小时；获取列表时报的 Codex 版本也会参考桌面版自带的 CLI 和 Codex 自己记录的版本，桌面版自动更新后不会再按旧版本拿到少一截的列表。
  • OpenCode 升级到 2.x 后，之后在 1.x 里新建或继续的会话不计入用量（#8363，见 #8361）：新旧两套数据并存时现在两套都读，同一条消息只算一次。以前扫描过的数据库从上次扫描处继续，不回补更早的记录。
  • 用量页自定义日期手动输入年份时，一输入就变成 1905（见 #9699）：现在输入完整的日期才生效，输入过程中不会被改写。
  • Antigravity 多个模型在用量统计里显示「未定价」：Gemini Flash 的 tiered 版本（如内置浏览器子代理用的 gemini-3.8-flash-tiered）按 Flash 基础价计费（#9600）；Hydrogen 的 tiered 版本按基础价计费（#9706，见 #9705）；用 Orchestrator 时的执行步归到 Gemini 4 Hydrogen（#9686，见 #9685），规划步归到 Gemini 4 Neon 并新增它的价格（#8845）；Claude 的 Thinking 版本（如 Claude Opus 4.6 (Thinking)）按对应的基础模型计费。已有的未定价记录会自动补算。
  • Claude Desktop 路由模式下模型列表留空，用的是默认的 Claude 模型名而不是供应商的模型（见 #9735）：路由模式本来如此，表单提示现在写清楚了：直连时留空会自动读取 /v1/models，路由模式下要用供应商的模型请填写模型列表。
  • DeepSeek Harness 的 home 级 cordis.patch.yml 里的 MCP 在 CC Switch 里看不到，也没有说明（见 #9714）：CC Switch 只读写各 profile 的文件，MCP 导入对话框现在写明 home 级文件既不读也不写，其中的 MCP 请在那里管理。
